Doomspire Defense is a tower defense game based off of Doomspire Brickbattles. You are on the Blue side, fend off other teams like green, yellow, and red, from taking down your Spire! Each round you are rewarded Bricks, XP, and Bux. Bricks are used to purchase new towers to use, XP is used to level up which earns you special rewards, and Bux is to buy cool cosmetics! 
Each and every tower is unique and good in their own ways, creating weird loadout combinations and strategies.
